Visit OpenSearch Dashboards and create a dashboard
After you create a data source, OpenSearch Service provides you with an OpenSearch Dashboards
URL. You use this to query your data using SQL or PPL. The Security Lake integration comes with
pre-packaged query templates for SQL and PPL to get you get started analyzing your logs.
For more information, see the section called “Conﬁguring a Security Lake data source”.
